name: wdio-ai-test-lab
description: Prompt-to-test lab: describe a test case in English, get a verified WebdriverIO spec for Web, Android and iOS.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace framework && npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace framework && npm run test --workspace server
